description: Converts a numeric rank to a credit rating. Look up the scale first, then the number. 1 is the best rating and 22 is default, so a lower number is better. This is the reverse of credit_rating_scale.json.
notes: JSON object keys are always strings, so convert the number to a string before the lookup (e.g. '10').
The scale keys match the allowed values of borrower.rank ('S&P', 'Moody', 'Fitch').
Moody has no entry at 22, and Fitch has no entries at 17 and 19. A lookup that finds nothing means that scale has no grade at that rank.
Rank 22 returns 'D'. S&P 'SD' and Fitch 'RD' also map to 22 in credit_rating_scale.json but are not returned here.
Ranks 1-10 are investment grade; 11-21 are speculative grade; 22 is default.
